en: Black‑and‑white postcard image showing vaulted arcades opening onto a busy urban square. Two men in early 20th‑century dress stand under the arches near advertising columns. In the background is an ornate historicist building with a dome and statues, carts or stalls, and shop signs. German text is visible on advertising boards and hanging signs. Along the bottom border, a caption identifies the location as arcades at the square in Graz.
